title: Video: Sonic's 'Memories And Beyond' 35th Anniversary Animation Released
summary:
Can Sonic and friends defeat Metal Sonic?

Earlier this year, Sega announced a new Sonic the Hedgehog 35th anniversary animation short, titled ' Memories and Beyond'. Now, months on, it's been officially released.

It runs for around 13 minutes and has a story by Takashi Iizuka and written by Ian Flynn. It sees Sonic and friends try to stop Dr. Eggman from harnessing the power of the Chaos Emeralds to upgrade Metal Sonic into the "ultimate fighting machine".

title: Japanese Charts: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Physical Takes The Lion's Share Of Its Japanese Sales
summary:
Physical is dead, eh?

After Nintendo's reveal this week that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time had shifted 5.2 million units in its first four days, it will come as no surprise to hear that it's a smash hit in Japan. But still, Famitsu's latest numbers are in, and the physical is flying!

According to this week's chart, Link's latest produced ~537,000 physical sales in its chart debut — giving it the lion's share of Japan's 810,000 sales that Nintendo reported, and leaving around 273,000 sales for digital. As we say, it's hardly surprising, but still!

title: Review: Harold Halibut (Switch 2) - A Creative Marvel That Suffers In The Back Half
summary:
Harold and flawed.

This won’t be the first Harold Halibut review to mention being wowed by one of the game’s pre-launch trailers during its release on other platforms back in 2024. Back then, the game’s stop-motion aesthetic — with character models based on scans of real marionettes, and its tactile hand-wrought sets — looked like nothing I’d ever seen.

Coupled with the atmospheric music and the promise of engaging characters and ambitious emotional storytelling, it became, in my eyes, an absolute must-play. And of course it did – its story of a crashed spaceship and its crew, stranded on an ocean planet, looked like a Wes Anderson animation, like Isle of Dogs or Fantastic Mr Fox. In terms of defining what games are capable of, I was ready for Harold Halibut to set new standards. I was convinced it would be a sure-fire 10/10.
